import Snippet from "../../../../components/docs/Snippet.astro";

The Python drop-in reads the device's license document from the `X-PKey-License` header, verifies it offline against your pinned keys and refuses the request when the license doesn't allow it. A route with no gate stays open. The contract is on [Verify licenses on your server](/docs/build/servers/).

Requires the License feature and the config file `pkey sdk --lang python --write` writes. The app sends `X-PKey-License` and `X-PKey-Device` with each call to your server.

## Steps

1. **Server** Install the SDK with the extra: `pip install "polaris-key[fastapi]"`, and generate the config file with `pkey sdk --lang python --write`.
2. **Server** Build one `PolarisKey` from the config at start-up and call `polaris.install(app)`.
3. **Server** Add a gate as a dependency on each route: `require_license`, `require_entitlement`, `require_tier` or `require_sign_in`.

<Snippet
  src="packages/shared-manifest/test/fixtures/integration/python/server/licensing.fastapi.py"
  title="main.py"
/>

The dependency adds the `X-PKey-License` scheme to `/docs`. `auth.license` can be `None` to a type checker, so `get_polaris_license(auth)` returns the license without a check. `polaris.install(app)` registers the refusal handler and sets `Cache-Control: private` on every gated response that has none.

## Require a signed-in account

`require_sign_in()` refuses with `sign_in_required` (403) while no account is signed in on the device. Behind it, `auth.user.subject` is the account's pairwise subject.

<Snippet
  src="packages/shared-manifest/test/fixtures/integration/python/server/identity.fastapi.py"
  title="main.py"
/>
